overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-allocation performance, and establishing a compact tick-based event log for endgame analysis.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
acceptance_criteria: Hash function is deterministic across platforms.
Unit tests verify hash consistency for identical state sequences.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures reliable save/load functionality, preventing corruption in long-running simulations.

tasks.title: Optimize Colonist Psychology State Transitions with Zero-Allocation Enums
acceptance_criteria: State transitions are O(1) with no dynamic memory.
Enum values are stable across compilations.
Integration tests confirm correct state propagation in 5,500-tick simulation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Improves simulation speed and responsiveness, allowing for larger colony sizes without lag.

tasks.title: Compact Tick-Based Event Log for Endgame Analysis
acceptance_criteria: Log capacity is fixed at 10,000 entries.
No heap allocations; uses static array.
Events are retrieved in chronological order.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides concise, readable summaries of simulation events for quick review and debugging.
